question:
A paper ribbon $27 \mathrm{~cm}$ long is divided into four rectangles of different sizes. Two segments each connect the centres of two adjacent rectangles, as shown. Find the sum of the lengths of these two segments.
<image1>
Choices:
A:$12 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$13.5 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$14 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$14.5 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:The number depends on the division
